items.escena: A clay page with one thick raised line at the top of a paragraph, painted bright green, while the lines below it stay plain and flat
A clay page where one green line at the top has two thinner amber lines branching down from it on short clay stems
A clay paragraph block whose very first line is lifted slightly above the rest like a lid, with a small clay flag planted on it
A small clay pillar holding up one end of a raised clay plank, with two tiny blocks stacked under it as props
A row of clay word tiles on a rail with one tile pulled forward and standing taller than the rest, a small key shape resting on it
A chunky green clay highlighter resting mid-stroke across a printed clay page, leaving a thick painted band over one line
A tall stack of clay pages beside a single short clay card, joined by a clay funnel narrowing from the stack to the card
Three rounded clay cards stacked in a tree, the largest on top, joined by chunky clay branches to two smaller ones below
A clay book lying open with a title bar, a small photo block and a folded corner tab modelled around the edges of the page, the body lines left plain
